text: M11 L14 (m11dcmds) says an unknown `--root-id` on a page command — at 2.1.8 also a system root id such as `plans` — ends with `INVALID_ARGUMENT` carrying the list of `kind: pages` roots in `message`. Since the page commands became server-delegating (0.2.13) they go through `/api/pages/:rootId/...`, whose router refuses an id it cannot resolve BEFORE the core is reached: HTTP 404 `ROOT_NOT_FOUND`, message `root '<id>' not found`, the page roots in `hint` (src/server/routes/pages.ts, `resolve`). The router resolves only `kind: pages` runtimes, so `plans` and an unknown id get the identical refusal and the list never names a system root — the 2.1.8 change holds — but the code and the field carrying the list predate the window and differ from the text. MCP and in-process callers do get the core's `INVALID_ARGUMENT` (src/server/discovery/roots.ts). The build keeps `ROOT_NOT_FOUND` on REST/CLI: it is part of the REST error catalog (core-operations.ts, error-codes.ts) and pinned by route tests, and renaming it is a transport contract change outside this window.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0009 — REST/CLI page commands keep answering an unknown or system `rootId` with 404 ROOT_NOT_FOUND (page roots in `hint`); only MCP/in-process callers get the core's INVALID_ARGUMENT.
